;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Northern Mali conflict]]
**At least ten [[United Nations]] peacekeepers are killed and several others injured in a Islamist militant attack on their base in [[Mali]]'s northern [[Kidal Region]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/peacekeepers-killed-attack-mali-aguelhoc-camp-190120132538469.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two people died and 25 more were injured, four seriously, in a fire at the ski resort of [[Courchevel]] in the [[French Alps]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2019/0120/1024415-france-ski-fire/ (RTE)]

;International relations
*[[Chad–Israel relations]]
**[[Chad]] and [[Israel]] restore diplomatic relations with each other after [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] meets with [[List of heads of state of Chad|Chadian President]] [[Idriss Déby]] in [[N'Djamena]]. Chad severed ties with Israel in 1972. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/193545-190119-netanyahu-embarks-for-chad-on-historic-visit-to-renew-diplomatic-ties?utm_source=twitter.com&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=international&utm_content=en1 (i24 News)]
